Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Pranav Goyal. I am a 26-year-old nurse living in New Delhi. My employer M/s Hegde Technologies Pvt Ltd owes me INR 48,90,000/- after firing me, and the employee was dismissed without any enquiry. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 09513100923 or email pranav.goyal39@example.com.
